name: ConfigCat
description: ConfigCat is a hosted feature flag and remote configuration service with products, configs, environments, flags, settings, targeting rules, and percentage rollouts.
agentUseSummary: Connect dedicated read-only Public API credentials bound to one non-production config. Relay approval-gates bounded flag metadata reads while served values, variations, environments, targeting rules, SDK keys, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: CONFIGCAT_PUBLIC_API_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: ConfigCat Public API username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated ConfigCat Public API credential for a read-only member.

credentialRequirements.name: CONFIGCAT_PUBLIC_API_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: ConfigCat Public API password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the matching Public API password encrypted.

credentialRequirements.name: CONFIGCAT_CONFIG_ID
credentialRequirements.label: ConfigCat config ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production Config UUID.

capabilities.label: Read feature flag metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded config-level flag metadata with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read ConfigCat flags
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded config-level feature flag metadata.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Public API usernames, passwords, and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read flag values or rollout rules
blocked.description: Served values, predefined variation values, environments, targeting and percentage rules, users, comparators, and SDK keys are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate ConfigCat
blocked.description: Flag, value, rule, environment, config, product, organization, webhook, tag, credential, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only one config's flag list and exact flag metadata GETs run on api.configcat.com; arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, value endpoints, evaluation, and alternate origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; read-only authority, fixed API/config routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; read-only authority, fixed API/config routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches encrypted Public API credentials server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches encrypted Public API credentials server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: ConfigCat requires a customer organization, dedicated read-only member/Public API credentials, and one config. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted staging credential outside this worker, configure username, password, and config ID in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: ConfigCat's official OpenAPI pins Basic authentication, fixed config flag list and exact flag metadata GETs, response fields, rate-limit headers, and separate mutation/value routes.
ConfigCat documents the Public Management API, Public API credentials, fixed api.configcat.com origin, and the distinction between metadata management and flag evaluation.
